kal tak

items.context: Can you please confirm your complaint ID
items.text: thik hai

items.context: Do you have your registered mobile number handy
items.text: wait a minute

items.context: Are you able to access your account online
items.text: ji haan
mera complaint solve nahi hua ab kya karna hai
maine pehle bhi call kiya tha par koi action nahi liya
woh last week ka issue hai jo ab tak pending hai
accha matlab aapko complaint escalate karna hai right
mera bill galat aya hai aur payment bhi deduct ho gaya
kya aap mujhe escalation process samjha sakte ho
mera naam Rahul Sharma hai aur account number 1234 hai

items.context: When did you first report this issue
items.text: maine Tuesday ko call kiya tha nahi Wednesday ko

items.context: Have you received any update regarding the complaint
items.text: abhi tak koi update nahi aaya hai problem pe

items.context: May I know your location and network status
items.text: main Delhi se bol raha hoon aur network bahut slow hai

items.context: Would you like to escalate this complaint to a senior agent
items.text: main chahata hoon ki aap mujhe higher authority se baat karwao

items.context: Are you facing any urgent issues with your account status
items.text: haan mujhe lagta hai mera account block hone wala hai ab
maine kal apne complaint ko register karwaya tha par aaj tak koi response nahi mila mujhe thoda sa help chahiye
mera payment deduct ho gaya hai lekin mujhe service activate nahi hui hai is baare mein kuch bata sakte hain kya
main kaafi baar phone kar chuka hoon aur bar bar wait karna pad raha hai tab bhi solution nahi mil raha mujhe escalation chahiye

items.context: Can you please describe the problem you are facing with your connection
items.text: maine pehle bataya tha ki mera net band hai par abhi tak koi technician bhi nahi aaya

items.context: What issues are you facing with your latest bill
items.text: main frustrated hoon kyunki mera bill galat aaya hai aur payment bhi double deduct ho gaya hai

items.context: Would you like me to escalate your complaint to the higher authority
items.text: kya aap mere complaint ko escalate kar sakte hain kyunki iska solution ab tak nahi mila hai

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: telecom
Intent: escalate_complaint - is unhappy that an earlier complaint was not solved and wants escalation
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with fillers and hesitations (umm, matlab, woh, accha, haan ji); at least a third include a self-correction ('Tuesday, nahi, Wednesday')

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
